text:
olivia: FYI billing spike for acct acme-inc — trial credits dropped ~60k in last 2h. Billing page shows embeddings/rerank API calls. Customer insists they didn't kick off anything. Can we triage? :eyes:

matt: any sample request ids or logs? was this during a deploy or cron window?

olivia: pulling logs now. saw a ton of repeated calls from our background worker 'vec-sync-cron' to /v1/embeddings. Example from prod logs:
```
2026-03-16T18:01:02Z vec-sync-12 POST /v1/embeddings 502 id=job-88f2 attempts=1
2026-03-16T18:01:05Z vec-sync-12 RETRY enqueue job-88f2 attempts=2
2026-03-16T18:01:08Z vec-sync-12 POST /v1/embeddings 502 id=job-88f2 attempts=2
2026-03-16T18:01:11Z vec-sync-12 RETRY enqueue job-88f2 attempts=3
```
Looks like automatic retries kept re-sending the same batch and each call consumed credits (embeddings billing).

sam: hmm — are we seeing 502 from runtime or 401? If the auth refresh failed then worker might have treated it as terminal and requeued incorrectly. Can you paste the small portion of worker code that does requeue?

olivia: here's the retry block (simplified):
```
if resp.status >= 500:
  enqueue(job)  # no idempotency token, whole batch requeued
elif resp.status == 401:
  refresh_token() and enqueue(job)
else:
  mark_done(job)
```

we have no idempotency header set for these background batches. Also noticed the runtime returned transient 502s during a regional kernel swap at 18:00.

matt: so two failure modes: transient 502 from runtime + worker requeueing full batch without dedupe -> duplicate embedding calls -> credit burn.

sam: repro steps that hit it locally: start vec-sync job with 10 items, simulate a 502 on the embeddings endpoint for the first two requests, let worker retry with same job id — you'll see 3x the token usage. Workaround: add an idempotency key (X-Client-Job) and have the embeddings service dedupe on that OR persist a processing lease so requeues don't re-run succeeded items.

jordan: we should refund the customer's trial credits while we fix. I submitted a credits grant for 50k to acme-inc (ticket #CS-8421). Also opened a patch PR to add idempotency header in vec-sync and reduce max attempts to 3.

carla: added note to the customer about a temporary credit grant + asking them to stop any scheduled syncs until we confirm. Also flagged for account review.

oncall-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-3147 (low-latency-runtime 502 cause, retry storm) :zap:

support-bot: PSA: if you see unexpected embeddings billing from background workers, check for missing X-Idempotency or missing per-record checkpointing.

matt: next steps: (1) rollback aggressive retry change in vec-sync, (2) ship idempotency header + server-side dedupe, (3) add billing alert for >10k trial embed tokens/hr, (4) run backfill to detect duplicate calls and annotate usages so finance can reconcile.

olivia: done on #1 and #3 in staging; PR for #2 is up for review (link). I also pushed a quick server-side guard that ignores duplicate job ids for 10m. We'll monitor and follow up with CS. :thumbsup:

jordan: CS notified customer, applied credits, will follow up when fix is in prod.

carla: adding postmortem checklist and will schedule a short retro with eng + billing tomorrow.

olivia: thanks all — keeping thread open until we see normal credit rate.
